text.en: Hokkaido Ainu lost vowel length, and pitch accent became phonemic, as seen in minimal pairs such as *nína* 'collect firewood' versus *niná* 'crush' ⟦claim:prosody/pitch-accent-placement-rule--hokkaido-ainu-lost-vowel-length-and-pitch-accent⟧. In Common Ainu, the original trochaic foot was most likely replaced by the iambic foot that dominates in historical varieties ⟦claim:prosody/pitch-accent-placement-rule--in-common-ainu-the-original-trochaic-foot-was⟧.
text.ja: 北海道アイヌ語は母音長を失い、*nína*「薪を拾う」対*niná*「すり潰す」のような最小対にみられるようにピッチアクセントが音素化した⟦claim:prosody/pitch-accent-placement-rule--hokkaido-ainu-lost-vowel-length-and-pitch-accent⟧。共通アイヌ語においては、本来の強弱音脚が、歴史的諸方言において支配的である弱強音脚へと置換された可能性が高いとされる⟦claim:prosody/pitch-accent-placement-rule--in-common-ainu-the-original-trochaic-foot-was⟧。
